personal.name: Sujeeth Sundarajan Rajkumar
personal.title: AI Engineer
personal.tagline: AI Engineer | Building LLM, RAG & Agentic AI Solutions
personal.bio: I'm an AI Engineer passionate about turning emerging AI capabilities into practical, production-ready systems.
personal.closingBio: The best AI system isn't necessarily the one with the most sophisticated model. It's the one that solves a meaningful problem, works reliably, and creates measurable value. That's the kind of AI I'm interested in building.
story: My work sits at the intersection of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, machine learning, and software engineering. I enjoy building systems that don't just demonstrate what AI can do, but are engineered to be reliable, scalable, and useful in real-world applications.

My journey started with software engineering, where I developed backend systems, worked with databases and APIs, and built cloud-based applications. That foundation eventually led me toward AI and machine learning, where I became particularly interested in how large language models can be combined with traditional engineering to create intelligent applications.

Today, I focus on building LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled APIs. I'm especially interested in the engineering challenges behind production AI — context retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, reliability, latency, and making AI systems work consistently outside of a demo environment.
I also enjoy learning in public through technical writing, research, and experiments with emerging AI technologies.

projects.description: An AI-powered Chrome extension that analyzes job postings, detects duplicate applications, and generates tailored ATS-optimized resumes using the user's master resume and LLMs.
projects.longDescription: AI Job Assistant is a Chrome extension designed to streamline manual job applications while keeping the applicant in control. It automatically extracts job posting information from career websites, supports review and editing, detects duplicate applications, stores a master resume, and provides an AI architecture for generating truthful, ATS-optimized resumes tailored to individual job descriptions.
